title: Machine transition states
statement: For a type $S$ and a natural number $n$, define the transition-state type to have the following constructors: a selector state carrying an index in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and an $n$-bit Boolean vector; an $f_A$ state carrying a Boolean and such a vector; an $f_B$ state carrying two Booleans and such a vector; copy, rewrite-$X$, rewrite-$C$, and rewrite-output states, each carrying such a vector; decode and return states, each carrying a vector, an element of $S$, an output-register value, and a Boolean; and weak-decode and weak-return states, each carrying a vector, an optional element of $S$, an output-register value, and a Boolean.
